nodes.label: Use defer or async on Script Tags
nodes.rationale: Scripts without defer/async block HTML parsing, delaying FCP and TTI. defer downloads in parallel and preserves order (DOM-dependent scripts); async executes when ready (independent scripts like analytics). In Next.js prefer next/script with strategy. Impact: HIGH.

nodes.label: next/script component
nodes.rationale: Next.js script component with strategy prop (afterInteractive, beforeInteractive) — preferred over raw script tags.
